sources.title: GitHub - daylight-00/PREpiBind: Protein Representation-integrated ...
sources.snippet: PREpiBind predicts MHC class II–peptide binding by leveraging pre-trained protein language model (PLM) representations. It encodes epitope sequences on-the-fly with ESM C 300M and uses pre-computed HLA embeddings for both alpha and beta chains, feeding them into a lightweight self-attention architecture to produce a binding score.
